reader.requirement: At 85 a report file named in an I-O-CONTROL SAME clause gets the Sequential I-O SAME clause's meaning (§1985:VII.2.13.4 GR1): the files of a SAME AREA clause share all storage areas, so only one may be open at a time; the compiler must accept a report file in a SAME AREA clause (and in SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA, XI.2.5) and run each file correctly when they are opened in turn. The witnesses cover compile-time acceptance only (pb1087_same_clauses_legal); l1c28 runs SAME AREA with no report file.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Year < 2002 gives the report-file row its 1985 limits (SAME AREA at most 1, SAME RECORD AREA 0, SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA unlimited, per §1985:XIII.2.4.3 SR2) where 2002+ bars the sort-merge-area format

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/DialectLevel/Year in FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs (only SameOccurrenceRule branches); the runtime has no SAME AREA code (SAME AREA is a storage-sharing permission; StorageSharingFiles feeds only the FROM/INTO record-area check)
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a report file may also appear in SAME SORT / SORT-MERGE AREA clauses (2002+ refuse that); the SAME AREA meaning is the same
reader.witnesses-cover: part: compile-time acceptance only; no witness runs a report file and another file of one SAME AREA clause in turn

reader.notes: GR2 is a pointer rule: its content is the VII SAME clause applied to report files. The compiler accepts the 85 forms, refuses the forbidden ones citing the 1985 text, and runs a report file and a sequential file of one SAME AREA clause correctly when opened in turn. Opening both at once is accepted, which 1985 leaves undefined. The SR10 refusal cites §2023 although §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR5c states the same rule.

refuter.evidence: GR2 points to the whole VII-19 SAME clause, so I attacked its syntax rules as well as the reader's GR1. SAMR3C (SAME AREA FOR FA FB RPT-FILE + SAME RECORD AREA FOR FA FB): refused COBOL2738 for omitting RPT-FILE, which matches §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR3c, since a report file cannot enter a RECORD clause. SAMNST (a contained program's SAME AREA naming the container's report file): refused COBOL2738, matching §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR1. SAMSM (SAME AREA FOR RPT-FILE SQ, SAME SORT-MERGE AREA FOR SRT RPT-FILE SQ, SAME SORT AREA FOR SR2 SQ RPT-FILE): accepted at 85 (the SORT-MERGE spelling, and a report file in two sort-area clauses per §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR5c). At run time it wrote the report, wrote SQ, reopened the report file EXTEND and read SQ back: 'READ [ZZ] 00 / READ [AA] 00', report ' R1',' R2'. A report file cannot be EXTERNAL or GLOBAL in the 85 report FD format (XIII.3.2.2), so the SR2 external arm cannot be reached. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.2.4.4 GR2; OK §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR1; OK §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR3c; OK §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR5c.
